[[Your Child (DS)|Possible son]] |rival = [[Gustafa (DS)|Gustafa]] |wife lunches = |unlock by = |appearances = [[Nami (AWL)|AWL, AWLSE, AnWL]], '''DS, Cute''', [[Nami (MM)|MM]], [[Nami (MLS)|MLS]], [[Nami (SoSAWL)|SoSAWL]]}} {{Youmay|Nami, a character from [[Harvest Moon: DS|Harvest Moon DS]]|[[Nami]] in other appearances that she makes in the series.}} {{Nihongo|Nami|ナスカ|Nasuka}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]. ''She is one of the eligible bachelorettes available to court in ''DS.'' Nami can be a hard person to read, as she has a quiet and apathetic personality. She doesn't let people get close to her, and working up a friendship with Nami can be difficult. She's a traveler who has no real employment. She lives at the Inn with [[Ruby (DS)|Ruby]], and sees her as a mother figure. She often wanders around the valley, and her schedule is very sporatic. She likes to spend time on the Inn's first floor, at the beach, or at the turtle pond. In the evenings, she will sometimes go to the Blue Bar or back to the Inn. Unlike most girls, Nami doesn't enjoy flowers or jewelries. She does love cooked dishes (especially curry), and fish. Your rival for Nami's affection is Gustafa, who also loves to travel. Unlike in ''A Wonderful Life'', Nami will never leave the valley if you do not marry her. She will stay with Ruby at the Inn. ''*Only if married to Gustafa'' |- |6am - 8am |Inside Yurt |- |8am - 9:10am |Walking to the Inn |- |9:10am - 5pm |Inside Inn |- |5pm - 9:30pm |Inside Blue Bar |- |9:30pm – 10:50pm |Walking to Yurt |- |10:50pm - 6am |Inside Yurt |} ==Gifts[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/nami.php Nami Likes/Dislikes] fogu.com== {{Infobox Gift |special = Gratin |loved = Wild Grape, Grape Juice, Red Magic Flower, Spring Sun, Summer Sun, Fall Sun, Winter Sun, Lithograph, Curry Bread, Tempura, Hot Chocolate, Stew, Curry Rice, Apple Pie, Grape |liked = Fish (All), Alexandrite, Mythic Stone, Ruby, Topaz, Peridot, Fluorite, Agate, Dog Ball, Omelet, Omelet Rice, Doughnut, Risotto, Wild Grape Wine, Wine, Relax Tea, Pickled Cucumber, Emerald, Marmalade, Baked Corn, Doria, Baked Yam, Sweet Potato, Cookie, Chocolate Cookie, Fruit Juice, Fruit Latte, Mixed Juice, Mixed Latte, Ketchup, Green Dumpling, Chimaki, Pickled Turnip |disliked = All Grasses, All Jewelry, Toy Flower, Pinkcat Flower, Diamond, Yarn, Copper, Silver, Gold, Mystrile, Orichalc, Adamantite, Sandrose, Moonstone, Pink Diamond, Weed, Stick, Stone, Lumber, Material Stone, French Fries, Pumpkin Stew, Bodigizer, Turbojolt, Bodigizer XL, Turbojolt XL, Pudding, Pumpkin Pudding, Ice Cream, Elli Leaves |hated = Wool, Apple Jam, Strawberry Jam, Toadstool, Pirate Treasure, Fish Fossil, Fish Bones, Empty Can, Boot, Golden Lumber, Fodder, Bird Feed, Jam Bun, Vegetable Juice, Vegetable Latte |horror = Grape Jam }} ==Heart Events== '''Black Heart Event''' Enter Inner Inn between 12pm and 2pm on rainy Tuesday.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/nami.php Nami Heart Events] fogu.com Nobody is around when you enter the Inn, so you ring the bell a few times. Nami comes out from the kitchen, annoyed by the sound of the bell. Nami tells you that Ruby has left to run errands but offers to help you. Tell her that you would like to stay the night. Nami knows you joking since you live in the Valley, but thinks it's pretty funny that you'd ask! She tells you to stay as long as you'd like since they don't get many guests. {{Clr}} ---- '''Purple Heart Event''' Enter Inner Inn lobby between 6am and 12pm when Nami has a purple heart or more. The black heart event must have already been triggered previously.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/nami.php Nami Heart Events] fogu.com When you enter the Inn, Ruby calls Nami down for you. While you wait for Nami to come meet you, Ruby excuses herself to the kitchen. Nami tells you that she's wanted to ask you about how farming works because it interests her. But she was too embarrassed to ask with other people around! If you tell her that you will show her a few things, you show how to use a few of your tools as a demonstration. Nami is pleased that she was able to learn a lot. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart Event''' Wake up in the morning when Nami has a blue heart or more, after viewing all previous events for the chance to trigger this event.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/nami.php Nami Heart Events] fogu.com You will hear a knock on your door first thing in the morning. The person knocking is asking for a favor. If you choose to let the person in, it turns out to be Nami! Nami is sorry for coming so early in the morning but she has something she just has to ask you about. Nami has a selection of three different gifts picked out to give to Ruby as a "thank you" for helping Nami so much. The problem is that Nami can't seem to pick just one thing to give Ruby and would like your help. If you tell Nami you'll help her, she thanks you and asks you to choose. It doesn't matter which of the three items you choose. Nami will thank you regardless of what you choose before leaving. {{Clr}} ---- '''Yellow Heart Event''' Exit your farmhouse between 6am and 12pm on a sunny day when Nami has a yellow heart or more. Additionally, all previous heart events must have already been viewed.[https://fogu.com/hm6/chan3/nami.php Nami Heart Events] fogu.com You will see Nami outside your front door as you leave. She asks if she would like to do something together. But perhaps she's just in the way? If you assure her that she's not in the way, Nami is glad and suggests hanging out at the beach. Nami talks to you about how she's traveled many places in the world, but she feels that the Valley has the best atmosphere of all. She also feels like the people who live here are all kind. She wonders if you feel the same way. You agree with her, which makes Nami happy that you both agree. After the conversation, you will end up back on the farm. Nami thanks you for spending time with her today before leaving. ==Rival Heart Events== '''Black Heart''' Leave the beach between 3pm and 6pm on a sunny day. It cannot be Tuesday or Thursday.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Gustafa and Nami are talking about the freedoms of traveling. Gustafa feels that people who travel are open-minded and kind. Nami tells Gustafa that she gets that feeling from him. Gustafa thanks her. {{Clr}} ---- '''Blue Heart''' Enter the beach area between 12pm and 3pm on a sunny day. It cannot be a Tuesday or Thursday and it must be Year 2 or later. Additionally, the first rival event have been previously seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Gustafa and Nami are walking on the beach when Gustafa comments on how pretty the ocean is. Nami appreciates it too, since she didn't get to see much of it when she was traveling. Gustafa explains to Nami that he stays in the valley for the wonderful scenery and the people. When he asks why Nami stays, she doesn't have an answer for him, so Gustafa leaves her to her thoughts.{{Clr}} ---- '''Green Heart''' Enter the beach area between 12pm and 3pm on a sunny day. It cannot be a Tuesday or Thursday and it must be Year 3 or later. Additionally, all previous rival events must have been already been seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Nami is looking out onto the ocean and thinking about her life. Gustafa sees her, and asks what she's thinking about. Nami asks Gustafa if it's okay for her to be content with how things are going right now. Gustafa tells Nami not to think too hard about it, and the answers will come naturally to her with some time. Nami thanks him. {{Clr}} ---- '''Orange Heart''' Walk from the pond to the beach between 12pm and 3pm on a sunny day. It cannot be a Tuesday or Thursday and it must also be Year 4 or later. All previous rival events must have already been seen.[http://www.fogu.com/hm6/chan3/rivals/gustafa.php Harvest Moon DS Rivals] fogu.com Gustafa and Nami are talking by the pond. Gustafa asks Nami if she plans on travelling more, but Nami doesn't think she needs to travel. She thinks that the valley suits her best, and she wants to say. Gustafa agrees that he also loves the valley, and tells Nami that his place is by her side. ==References== {{Reflist|3}} {{HMDSCharacters}} [[Category:Harvest Moon DS]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS Bachelorettes]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Characters]] [[Category:Harvest Moon DS: Cute Rivals]]
